pack.name: AI Recipes: Food & Maps

templates.name: AI Recipe: AI Map
templates.description: Claude researches 8–20 real places on a rotating theme and builds a standalone interactive Leaflet map with categories, popups and directions links, plus a companion guide, sources, and a cover.

parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Cover image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips the cover.
